a2-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: This Year in Class
a2-17-01.scenario: At the language exchange in Hanoi, Meg asks what you have done this year. You have learned a lot and you have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you have learned a lot this year and that you have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.target: Este año he aprendido mucho. He conocido a nuevos compañeros.
a2-17-01.english: This year I have learned a lot. I have met new classmates.
a2-17-01.canDo: I can talk about recent experiences and life events using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Happened Yesterday
a2-17-02.scenario: At the language exchange, Carlos asks what happened yesterday. The class finished and you remembered the first lesson.
a2-17-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that the class finished yesterday and that you remembered the first lesson.
cues: Say what happened to the class
a2-17-02.target: La clase terminó ayer. Recordé la primera lección.
a2-17-02.english: The class finished yesterday. I remembered the first lesson.
a2-17-02.canDo: I can recount completed past events using the pretérito indefinido.

a2-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: This Year and Last Year
a2-17-03.scenario: At the language exchange, Daniela asks about your progress. This year you have learned a lot, and last year you changed course.
a2-17-03.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have learned a lot this year and that you changed course last year.
cues: Say what you have done this year
Say what you did last year
a2-17-03.target: Este año he aprendido mucho. El año pasado cambié de curso.
a2-17-03.english: This year I have learned a lot. Last year I changed course.
a2-17-03.canDo: I can choose between the pretérito perfecto and indefinido when talking about past events.

a2-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Looking Back
a2-17-04.scenario: At the language exchange, Lucía asks how your Spanish is going. This year you have improved a lot, and last year you continued the course.
a2-17-04.prompt: Tell Lucía that you have improved a lot this year and that you continued the course last year.
cues: Say how you have improved this year
Say what you did last year
a2-17-04.target: Este año he mejorado mucho. El año pasado continué el curso.
a2-17-04.english: This year I have improved a lot. Last year I continued the course.
a2-17-04.canDo: I can choose the appropriate past tense in familiar A2 contexts.

a2-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Last Class
a2-17-05.scenario: After the last class at the language exchange, Meg asks you how it went. The teacher prepared some activities and everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.prompt: Tell Meg that the teacher prepared some activities and that everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.target: El profesor preparó unas actividades y todos se divirtieron mucho.
a2-17-05.english: The teacher prepared some activities and everyone had a lot of fun.
a2-17-05.canDo: I can talk about experiences, relationships and completed events in a final A2 narrative.

a2-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Year of Spanish
a2-17-consolidation.scenario: At the language exchange, Kaylee asks about your year and about yesterday. This year you have improved a lot and yesterday you finished the course.
a2-17-consolidation.prompt: Tell Kaylee that you have improved a lot this year and that you finished the course yesterday.
cues: Say what you have done this year
a2-17-consolidation.target: Este año he mejorado mucho y ayer terminé el curso.
a2-17-consolidation.english: This year I have improved a lot and yesterday I finished the course.
a2-17-consolidation.canDo: I can choose between the pretérito perfecto and indefinido in familiar A2 contexts.
